description: Source code for a video decoder class using libvpx for VP9 decoding, supporting decode-to-texture and decode-to-video frame output modes, with thread management and error handling.

classes.name: VideoDecoder
classes.description: A class for decoding VP9 video streams using libvpx, managing decoding threads, error reporting, and output modes.

methods.name: VideoDecoder::VideoDecoder
methods.description: Constructor initializing the video decoder with codec and output mode.

methods.description: Initializes decoder with status and error callback functions.

methods.description: Feeds input buffers into the decoder for processing.

methods.name: VideoDecoder::WriteEndOfStream
methods.description: Signals end of stream to flush remaining frames.

methods.name: VideoDecoder::Reset
methods.description: Resets the decoder state and cleans up.

methods.name: VideoDecoder::UpdateDecodeTarget_Locked
methods.description: Updates the decode target with the current frame.

methods.name: VideoDecoder::ReportError
methods.description: Reports an error and invokes the error callback.

methods.description: Destroys the decoder context and releases resources.
